HowItWorks.title: A community to move forward by building.
HowItWorks.description: No endless processes or impersonal forms. Join, participate, and let your work speak for itself.

01.title: Join the server
01.text: Join for free a community that shares your view on technology.

02.title: Participate & learn
02.text: Find your channel, solve doubts, and take part in tournaments with other devs.

03.title: Show your work
03.text: Build real projects and let your skills stand out.

04.title: Connect with companies
04.text: Companies discover you for your talent, not an automated filter.

ForTalent.title: Get recognized for what you can build.
ForTalent.description: Build a live profile showcasing your stack, experience level, projects, and availability. No ATS, no keywords, no fitting into rigid templates.

bullets.02: Connect with peers who share your interests
bullets.03: Receive opportunities tailored to your skillset

ForCompanies.title: Talent is best seen in action.
ForCompanies.description: Connect with developers actively learning, building, and collaborating. Meet your next team member by seeing how they work before hiring.

evaluate.title: Real-world evaluation
evaluate.description: See how they solve problems, communicate, and collaborate on shared projects.

brand.description: Be part of the spaces where tech talent learns and grows.

tournaments.title: Learn, compete, and build something to show.

networking.title: Your peers are just one channel away.
networking.description: Frontend, backend, data, UX, career, and more. Questions solved in minutes and conversations that go beyond the screen.
